name: Finance / PayFast Runtime
laws: PayFast is the payment processor, not Kingsmen truth.
Paid status requires verified payment evidence.
PayFast ITN receipts must be idempotent.
PayFast signatures must be verified before payment status changes.
CV Revamp must never invent fake experience, certificates, references, skills, or qualifications.
checkout_guard: Canonical package prices and quantities are represented in the finance and service catalogues. New paid checkout remains release-gated until the reviewed reconciliation migration is applied to staging and a real PayFast sandbox checkout, accepted ITN, duplicate replay, exact amount, paid-only activation and candidate-isolation evidence all pass. Live payments remain disabled.
